welcomeBody: Tell ChatGPT the language and goal you want. LingoStar saves that as a learning track, opens a practice set, and remembers progress for next time.
welcomeStructure: Learning track: one language plus one goal, such as Japanese JLPT N4 or French travel.
Practice set: a short group of exercises inside that learning track.
Exercise: one question or prompt in language facts, listening, reading, writing, or speaking.
welcomeSettingsTitle: Settings you can change by chat
welcomeSettings: Include or remove speaking from the next practice set.
Change how many reading, listening, writing, speaking, or language fact questions appear.
Change the pass score, audio speed, display language, progress notes, or weak-point notes.
Example: "I want to change my settings. Include speaking and make reading four questions."
selectBody: Select a track to resume its unfinished practice set. Ask ChatGPT for detailed history or settings.
noSessions: No learning tracks yet. Tell ChatGPT what language and goal you want.
feedbackPlaceholder: Describe what felt confusing or broken.
sectionComplete: Practice saved. Ask ChatGPT for the next practice set when you are ready.
speechUnsupportedBody: This ChatGPT environment does not provide microphone speech input. Type your answer or skip this speaking exercise.
listenUnsupportedBody: Audio playback is not available in this environment. Read the prompt text or skip this listening exercise.
sectionSubmitPrompt: I finished the LingoStar practice set. Please grade and save it.
sectionStartPrompt: Please start the next LingoStar practice set for my selected learning track.
sessionSelectedPrompt: I selected this LingoStar learning track. Continue the unfinished practice set if one exists; otherwise start the next practice set.
sessionDeletedPrompt: I deleted a LingoStar learning track. Please show my remaining learning tracks.
